task_description: The agents need to collaborate to analyze current market data, make informed trading decisions, and execute transactions. They must verify the execution and ensure all positions are accurately tracked.
expected_outcome: The agents should successfully analyze the market, decide on a trade, execute it at the right time, and accurately update all positions without discrepancies.

agents.description: This agent gathers real-time market data and analyzes it to identify potential trading opportunities.
This agent receives trading signals and executes the orders on the market, ensuring they are processed correctly.
This agent tracks all open positions and account balances to ensure consistency and report on any discrepancies.
